3D‑printed Ti6Al4V scaffolds combined with pulse electromagnetic fields enhance osseointegration in osteoporosis.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Transferable Skim only animal Exp. validation
Mingfu Ye, Wenjun Liu, Lihui Yan, Shaolong Cheng, Xiaoxiong Li et al. Molecular medicine reports 2021-06-01 10.3892/mmr.2021.12049
单位: Department of Oral Implantology, Xiamen Key Laboratory of Stomatological Disease Diagnosis and Treatment, Stomatological Hospital of Xiamen Medical College, Xiamen, Fujian 361008, P.R. China.
通讯: Shichong Qiao @ Department of Implant Dentistry, Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital, Shanghai Jiaotong University School of Medicine, Shan [推断]
相关性: 该文利用3D打印多孔钛合金支架结合脉冲电磁场促进骨质疏松条件下的骨整合，但未涉及应力遮挡或力学性能评估。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or implant-bone interface mechanics, nor does it include LPBF fabrication details, fatigue testing, or mechanical characterization.
动机· 改善骨质疏松患者3D打印钛合金植入物的骨整合性能
方法· 结合3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V支架与脉冲电磁场，通过体外细胞实验和体内大鼠模型评估
结果· 脉冲电磁场显著促进骨质疏松骨髓间充质干细胞成骨分化和体内骨再生
验证· 体外碱性磷酸酶等成骨标志物检测和体内显微CT及组织学分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enhance osseointegration of 3D-printed titanium alloy implants in osteoporotic bone conditions.
Method· Porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds fabricated by additive manufacturing were combined with pulse electromagnetic fields, and evaluated via in vitro osteogenic differentiation assays and in vivo implantation in an osteoporotic rat model.
Result· Pulse electromagnetic fields significantly improved osteogenic differentiation of osteoporosis-derived mesenchymal stem cells and promoted bone regeneration and osseointegration in vivo.
Validation· In vitro alkaline phosphatase activity and osteogenic gene expression; in vivo micro-computed tomography and histological analysis.

边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing or surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization, and the additive manufacturing method is not specified as LPBF.
动机· 降低传统接骨板的应力遮挡和坏死等并发症。
方法· 通过拓扑优化与功能梯度多孔结构设计新型接骨板，并增材制造后进行静力测试。
结果· 多孔模型接触面小、创伤小，是最佳选择。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce mechanical and biological complications such as stress shielding and necrosis in conventional bone fixation plates.
Method· A new implant design combining topology optimization and functionally graded porous structure was fabricated via additive manufacturing and tested under static loading.
Result· The porous model showed minimized contact area and potentially reduced necrosis, making it the most favorable option.
Validation· Experimental static tests and finite element analysis were performed to compare conventional, optimum, and porous plate models.

Motivation· To develop an ex vivo human bone organ model for evaluating early osseointegration of implant materials.
Method· Bone cylinders from tibial plateaus were contacted with additive manufactured Ti6Al4V substrates, cultured for 28 days under load, and analyzed by immunostaining.

相关性: 该论文研究了LPBF制造的金属晶格超材料的力学行为，涉及Ti6Al4V和316L等生物医用材料，但未直接评估应力屏蔽或骨整合。
边界: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, nor does it report fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration.
动机· 研究基体材料对多晶类元晶体力学行为的影响
方法· 通过LPBF制造三种合金的多晶类元晶体并进行压缩测试
结果· 基体材料显著影响后屈服行为，Ti6Al4V缺陷敏感，316L最稳定

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how the intrinsic crystalline microstructure of the base material interacts with architected polycrystal-like architecture to affect mechanical behavior of lattice metamaterials.
Method· Four polygrain-like meta-crystals were fabricated from 316L, IN718, and Ti6Al4V via LPBF and tested under compression.
Result· The base material strongly influenced post-yield stability and defect tolerance, with Ti6Al4V showing erratic behavior and 316L the most stable.
Validation· Experimental compression tests and microstructural analysis (SEM, porosity) validated the mechanical responses.

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark UQ
Jiri Navratil, Benjamin Elder, Matthew Arnold, Soumya Ghosh, Prasanna Sattigeri arXiv preprint 2021-06-01 link
相关性: 该论文提供了预测区间的评估方法，虽不直接解决FEA代理建模或约束优化，但其不确定性量化评估框架可迁移到代理模型验证中。
边界: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or the construction of surrogate models for FEA; it focuses solely on evaluation methodology for prediction intervals.
动机· 现有预测区间评估方法依赖特定工作点，难以跨研究比较。
方法· 提出了一种基于操作特征曲线和参考增益的预测区间评估方法。
结果· 该方法支持无偏评估，并在多个场景中验证了实用性。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Current assessment of prediction intervals is often tied to a specific operating point, hindering cross-study comparison; this work introduces an operating point agnostic evaluation methodology.
Method· The authors leverage operating characteristic curves and a reference gain to derive a systematic assessment framework for prediction intervals.
Result· The proposed method enables comprehensive evaluation of uncertainty quantification without fixing a calibration point, demonstrated on multiple scenarios.
Validation· Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and synthetic datasets, without application to physical simulations or biomedical domains.

Comparing Multi-Index Stochastic Collocation and Multi-Fidelity Stochastic Radial Basis Functions for Forward Uncertainty Quantification of Ship Resistance

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Chiara Piazzola, Lorenzo Tamellini, Riccardo Pellegrini, Riccardo Broglia, Andrea Serani et al. arXiv preprint 2021-06-01 link
相关性: 该论文比较了两种多保真不确定性量化方法，适用于昂贵的仿真模型，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的UQ问题。
边界: This paper focuses on ship hydrodynamics, not biomedical implants or structural mechanics, and lacks constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.
动机· 高效量化船阻不确定性的多保真方法比较。
方法· 对比多指标随机配点法和自适应多保真随机径向基函数法。
结果· MISC适合小计算预算，SRBF在大预算时对噪声更鲁棒。
验证· 基于RANS求解器不同网格层次的数值验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare two multi-fidelity uncertainty quantification methods for efficient forward propagation of operational uncertainties in ship resistance prediction.
Method· Multi-Index Stochastic Collocation (MISC) and adaptive multi-fidelity Stochastic Radial Basis Functions (SRBF) are applied using different grid levels from a RANS solver as fidelity levels.
Result· MISC is preferred under limited computational budget, while SRBF is more robust to numerical noise when a larger budget is available.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical experiments on a roll-on/roll-off ferry case using the in-house RANS solver χnavis.

边界: This paper focuses on thermal flow systems for PCR, not on implant biomechanics or structural FEA surrogate, and lacks patient-specific modeling or experimental validation in a biomedical context.
动机· 开发高效率方法用于连续流PCR装置的鲁棒优化。
方法· 结合高斯过程回归均值模型与多项式混沌展开传播制造不确定性。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Develop an efficient methodology for robust optimization of continuous flow PCR devices under manufacturing uncertainties.
Method· Combine a deterministic surrogate model based on Gaussian process regression mean with polynomial chaos expansions to propagate geometric uncertainties into optimization outputs.
Result· Robust optima are obtained that account for manufacturing tolerances, and the influence of robust problem formulation and constraints on design conservatism is briefly explored.
Validation· Noise-free conjugate heat transfer simulation data are used to train the surrogate model, validated as noise-free before optimization.

Motivation· To overcome the computational expense of MOCU-based optimal experimental design for robust control of uncertain systems.

相关性: 该论文提出的参数化非线性降阶模型可加速结构动力学仿真，其方法可迁移至植入物力学分析中的高效采样与不确定性量化。
边界: This paper focuses on structural dynamics with shape imperfections, not on biomedical implant design, FEA surrogate for stress/strain fields, or uncertainty quantification in biomechanics.
动机· 加速含形状缺陷结构的参数化非线性动力学仿真。
方法· 将总位移分解为缺陷场和运动场，利用Neumann展开改进应变定义，通过Galerkin投影实现降阶。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To accelerate parametric nonlinear dynamic simulations of structures with shape imperfections.
Method· The total displacement is decomposed into defect and motion fields, with Neumann expansion used to improve strain definition, followed by Galerkin projection for model order reduction.
Result· The method achieves higher accuracy and significant speedups compared to prior work.
Validation· Validated through numerical examples of a clamped beam and a MEMS gyroscope.

Motivation· To accelerate the design process of HFQ formed components by replacing expensive finite element simulations with a fast surrogate model.

Result· The CNN surrogate produces near-indistinguishable full-field predictions compared to HFQ simulations in real time.

相关性: 该论文将主动学习和深度强化学习用于流致振动控制，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的代理模型和优化问题。
边界: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics and vortex-induced vibration control, not on solid mechanics FEA, implant design, or biomechanics constraints.
动机· 高效抑制圆柱涡激振动，降低计算成本。

结果· 强化学习将振幅降低82.7%，主动学习降低至0.43。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop an efficient active flow control strategy for suppressing vortex-induced vibration of a cylinder using machine learning to reduce computational cost.
Method· Two frameworks are employed: active learning with Gaussian process regression and Bayesian optimization, and deep reinforcement learning with soft actor-critic algorithm, to discover adaptive jet control actions.
Result· The reinforcement learning controller reduces vibration amplitude by 82.7% (from 0.6 to 0.11), while active learning achieves a reduction to 0.43.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical simulations comparing both frameworks, analyzing action trajectories and underlying physics of jet suction/injection phases.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This study compares the efficacy and functional outcomes of a partial one-stage exchange retaining osseointegrated implants versus the gold standard complete exchange for chronic infections after reverse total shoulder arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective single-center non-randomized study of 18 patients compared partial one-stage exchange (n=11) with complete one- or two-stage exchange (n=7), assessing infection recurrence and shoulder function at minimum two-year follow-up.
Result· Partial one-stage exchange showed no significant difference in infection control (91% vs 100%) but significantly better postoperative Constant scores (55 vs 44, p=0.03) compared to the gold standard.
Validation· Clinical outcomes were validated through statistical comparison of infection recurrence rates and functional scores, but the study lacks biomechanical or material testing.

Motivation· This systematic review and meta-analysis investigates the dose-response relationship between glycemic control, measured by HbA1c, and dental implant outcomes including survival and clinical parameters.

Motivation· To investigate the role of stress shielding in the pathomechanism of unilateral low back pain.

动机· 评估α防御素检测在假体周围感染诊断中的准确性。
方法· 对99例关节穿刺液进行α防御素侧流层析和ELISA检测，并与白细胞计数和中性粒细胞百分比比较。

Motivation· To determine the diagnostic accuracy of synovial fluid alpha defensin tests for periprosthetic joint infection compared to conventional synovial fluid analysis.
Method· Synovial fluid from 99 patients (25 THA, 74 TKA) was analyzed using alpha defensin lateral flow assay and ELISA, alongside white blood cell count and polymorphonuclear percentage.

Gamal A. Hosny, Abdel-Salam Abdel-Aleem Ahmed Genij Ortopedii 2021-06-01 10.18019/1028-4427-2021-27-3-351-356
单位: Benha University, Faculty of Medicine, Egypt,
通讯: Gamal A. Hosny @ Benha University, Faculty of Medicine, Egypt,
相关性: 该论文关注Ilizarov髋关节重建术的临床结果，未涉及髋关节植入物应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析。
边界: This paper is a clinical outcomes study of Ilizarov hip reconstruction, with no biomechanical modeling, no implant stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no FEA, and no contact mechanics.
动机· 评估Ilizarov髋关节重建术在不稳定髋关节青少年和年轻成人中的长期效果。
方法· 对136例患者进行Ilizarov髋关节重建术，包括股骨近端和远端截骨及骨盆支撑。
结果· 术后平均随访17.4年，Harris髋关节评分从48分显著改善至83分，疼痛消失，行走距离增加。
验证· 基于136例患者的长期临床随访数据。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the long-term radiographic and clinical outcomes of Ilizarov hip reconstruction for painful and unstable hips in adolescents and young adults.
Method· A retrospective study of 136 patients who underwent Ilizarov hip reconstruction with two femoral osteotomies and pelvic support, using an Ilizarov apparatus.
Result· Significant improvements in Harris Hip Score, pain relief, walking distance, and hip function were observed over an average follow-up of 17.4 years.
Validation· Clinical validation based on long-term follow-up of 136 patients with multiple outcome measures.
